groups.title: Observed motion and occurrence thresholds
groups.reason: Nine tests pin loaded movement/climb ratios, route drift, treetop swoop frequency, sigil occupancy share, partner arrival, observed poses and the retained noisy picker’s excess crossings. These are outcome-dominated measurements; direct boundaries and ownership must remain separately protected. Second review adds two outcome-only docking/bot-success deadline measurements. Neither has an independent integrity assertion to retain; controlled pickup/cast/scatter contracts remain elsewhere. Report 6566767328.
groups.question: Move these eleven observed motion, occurrence and bot-success thresholds to nonblocking nightly/manual reports? Yes keeps the measurements and direct safety contracts; no gameplay change.
examples: loaded, she's slower moving away from the pull, not toward it or across it much, and drifts a little toward it
a partner stands beside the one who leads
dancers and idlers near a cluster of placed sigils end up off them
pulls from any side (Ed, 2026-10-12): a rune near her comes to her feet from north, south, east or west, round a follower in the way
the skilled bot converts a stone by casting it, then gathers its loose sigils (seed 11, the 10-area home)

groups.title: Mixed party, spread and route statistics
groups.reason: Sixteen mixed tests combine finite-sample extrema, density, activity, route diversity and arrival observations with direct rules. Preserve roster membership, angular bounds/replay, path/floor/seat exclusions, removed-piece absence, caps, deterministic guest places, reciprocal pairs, configured height/40m bounds, finite pulse lifecycle, crossing separation and unoccupied destinations. Two outcome-only declarations: pickup:81 measures docking by a 12-second deadline; stoneStacks:397 requires bot casting/stack success within 90 seconds. Neither contains a separate integrity assertion to retain. Five mixed declarations: pickup:63 retains rune/pickup-radius ordering, controlled in-range pickup and leash state, while six-second convergence reports; stoneStacks:219 retains repeatability while sampled shape variation reports; rules:619 retains fresh adjacent choices, forecast and wave identity while sampled noisy-picker preference reports; runestones:23 retains same/different-seed dealing while finite-sample flip variety reports. rules:641 retains formula-derived arrival order, monotone activation, all speakers, scheduling and pause shifts; fixed path length 195, 8–9.5-second first arrival and midpoint speaker-count pins need reporting or geometry-derived checks. Its older roughly-three-second comment and DECISION FOR ED remain unresolved against the north-west house geometry; no replacement timing ruling was found. Exact assertion dispositions: report 6566767328.
groups.question: Split these twenty-one mixed tests into blocking direct rules and nonblocking sampled measurements? Yes preserves or replaces geometry, ownership, pickup, repeatability, wave identity and scheduling checks; boot timing wording remains unresolved.
examples: strays each letter within inaccuracy degrees, both ways, and the same every time
deals guests out over the soundsystem and the party places, the same each time
keeps Ed's crossing rules on 40 seeds: at most 4 a map, none the pulse would pass over already drawn ahead of it, 350 m apart (Ed, 2026-10-06)
wakes exactly one area a wave, the one chosen in advance, always bordering the party (no islands), spreading away from the last (the noisy picker)

boots the home speakers up first, one by one, at the boot's own speed, then the pulse sets off for the first wave (Ed, 2026-10-04; the first speaker about 3 s off the decks, 2026-10-06; the pulse's speed, 2026-10-09; the boot's own, 2026-10-18)

groups.title: Invitation, phase and route contracts
groups.reason: Direct hit counts use constructed eligible targets, not emergent battles. Phase/state/identity sweeps prevent vacuous passes. Long pulse audits check EVERY step for monotone bounded fronts and exact wave coupling; curveWork is a real planning budget. Old modes remain explicit comparisons. Keep eligibility, personal runes, pickup priority/delay, per-step no-teleport/leash bounds, actor/bed isolation, current letters, wave identity/forecast, analytical pulse/intercept, pause, once-only activation, stack/cycle geometry, balanced dealing, explicit placement/cardinality/uniqueness and deterministic choices. Long loops provide direct safety/branch coverage. placement:14 explicitly enables setPieceChance 0.25 and older scenery families; its minimum coverage avoids a vacuous compatibility fixture. Older grid, cast-off, noisy-picker, proximity-talk and injected carried-flask states are explicitly selected, not current-default demands. Report 6566767328.

rulings: Ley-line supersession: old4/5Oct header advances on wave or quest ‘whichever comes first’; the8Oct ruling says ‘The pulse should never skip, it always travels along the route at the bpm speed’. leylines:41/88 explicitly opt into advance=first; :54 tests current default; leyPulseAudit:111 tests both. They are compatibility paths. The audit header saying Ed has not ruled is stale prose, not old behavior.

Witch-count supersession: DESIGN481 drops ‘one new area per witch’ on24Oct. leyPulseAudit:198’s two-witches title actually sets areasPerWave=2 in a SINGLE-witch game. Keep the explicit option’s timing check, but do not claim it proves multiplayer policy;1609 retains that design.

Party guest distinction: an older stopped-soundsystem case flies away;11Oct destroyed-soundsystem design retains the witch stargazing in pairs/threes. partyWitches.gaze:19 checks both ruined and merely stopped; the implementation branches on ruined. No obsolete fly-away assertion was established.
29Oct set-piece removal applies to normal generation; partyDressing:43 does not require any set piece to spawn, and :71 requires removed pieces absent. The title alone is not deletion evidence.

Baby invites changed31Oct. hexSigils:61 starts with already-carried babies; invites:114 uses a level1 stand-in and counting Affection. Neither asserts real baby invitation. Old partyspell prompt prose tests rules input and tool-game compatibility, not a restored start-screen UI.

Old wave-per-witch wording tests supplied areasPerWave. No obsolete whole test established. The old roughly-three-second boot prose versus 8–9.5-second assertion remains unresolved after the 24 October north-west treehouse geometry; IP2 flags it without choosing gameplay timing.
